commitments.target: Customer Support Chats and Call Transcripts
commitments.detail: Vendor shall delete all data within 30 days after the end of the service period or upon request.
Vendor must maintain at least $5,000,000 in cybersecurity insurance coverage.
Vendor must list the company as an additional insured party under the insurance policy.
Vendor must allow for annual audits of their systems and processes related to the handling of customer support data.
